      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Extracted categorical variable with well-separated, interpretable themes (billing, auth, ui, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against resolution time. Genuinely opens a new relationship axis absent from the original table."
    },

      "name": "theme_avg_resolution_minutes",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A precomputed group aggregate of the focus itself keyed by theme. It restates the focus rather than providing an external associational variable; grouping on it is equivalent to grouping on issue_theme, adding no independent relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "channel_avg_resolution_minutes",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Group mean of the focus by channel, which is already an original column. It is a derivative of the focus, not an external predictor, so it collapses exploration into a lookup of channel."
    },
    {
      "name": "priority_avg_resolution_minutes",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Group mean of the focus by priority (already present). Restates the focus keyed by an existing segmentation; not an independent associational variable."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolution_vs_theme_avg",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A residual of the focus minus its theme mean. This is a transform of the focus variable itself, with fine-grained near-unique values that support no clean segmentation; it is opaque restatement, not an external comparison axis."
    },
    {
      "name": "priority_numeric",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A numeric re-encoding of the existing priority column. Adds no new information beyond priority; it is a restatement of an existing segmentation dimension."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 1,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.25,
  "rationale": "Only issue_theme is a genuine new, interpretable segmentation variable that opens an informative relationship with resolution time. The remaining five columns are either precomputed group aggregates of the focus (theme/channel/priority averages), a residual transform of the focus, or a mere re-encoding of an existing column. These restate the focus or existing dimensions rather than introducing external associational variables, and one (resolution_vs_theme_avg) is too fine-grained to segment on. As a set they weakly support interpretable relationship discovery."
}
